title: A Bernstein Theorem for the Self-Shrinking $J$-Equation and Some Generalizations
summary: We prove that every entire smooth strictly plurisubharmonic solution of the self-shrinking $J$-equation on $\mathbb{C}^n$ is a quadratic polynomial. This removes the asymptotic lower bound assumption on the complex Hessian in \cite[Theorem 4]{HJ}. The result also recovers the corresponding real rigidity theorem in \cite[Theorem 1.1]{HOW} as a special case. More generally, our method applies to self-shrinking equations associated with a broad class of fully nonlinear elliptic operators satisfying suitable structural conditions, including the adjacent inverse complex Hessian quotient operators…
